newsitem.title: UK: Clubhaus to acquire four more golf courses.
newsitem.headline: Clubhaus to acquire four more golf courses.

text.p: British-based golf course operating company Clubhaus Plc said on Thursday it had acquired four golf courses in southern England, three of them in Essex, and planned to raise 15.7 million stg through a placement and open offer.
The company said it would raise the money by placing and offering 19.82 million new Clubhaus shares at a price of 82 pence a share.
The company' share price had held firm at its overnight closing price of 87 1/2 p.
Among the four golf courses, Clubhaus is paying the highest -- four million stg -- for Three Rivers Golf & Country Club, in Cold Norton, Essex.

Clubhaus is paying 2.87 million stg for Stapleford Abbots Golf Club in Romford, Essex and another 1.89 million stg for Benton Hall Golf Course Ltd, which owns the Benton Hall Golf Club in South Wickham in the same county.
The fourth acquisition is the Meyrick Park Golf Club in Bournemouth, Dorset in southern England. Clubhaus is paying 1.49 million stg in cash and 197,591 stg in the form of new Clubhaus shares.
The acquistions will boost Clubhaus's portfolio of golf courses to 11 in England. It also owns three in continental Europe.
